name: 5-Minute Microwave Granola

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, use a fork or small whisk to combine maple syrup, melted butter or oil, vanilla extract, salt, and cinnamon, if using. Add oats and nuts and toss to evenly coat. Transfer to a microwave-safe small plate and, using a spatula or back of a soup spoon, gently press mixture into a flat, even layer. Microwave on high power, stirring every 30 seconds, until oats are golden and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes.

Working quickly, in a medium bowl, stir dried fruit into the hot granola. (The granola should still be hot and pliable.) Transfer back to plate, then gently press into an even thin layer, and let cool completely, about 5 minutes. Break cooled granola into pieces of desired size. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: easy granola recipe, granola recipe, microwave granola recipe

description: Here's how to make chewy, crispy, and delightfully crumbly granola in under five minutes using your microwave. Sprinkle it over yogurt or eat it by the handful for an easy on-the-go snack.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Pinch cinnamon, optional

Optional substitutions: maple syrup → honey; melted unsalted butter → neutral oil such a vegetable or canola oil; chopped raw nuts seeds → seeds

Make-ahead and storage: Leftover granola can be stored at room temperature in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.
author: Leah Colins
